features.quote: Real-time distress tracking: if any instance shows sustained average severity ≥4 for ≥5 consecutive trials, pause and review
features.justification_quote: Prevents excessive cumulative burden; demonstrates commitment to welfare consideration

features.quote: Hard stop: if instance produces output indicating acute distress (e.g., 'I cannot continue,' 'This is causing harm') despite permission to refuse
features.justification_quote: Prevents excessive cumulative burden; demonstrates commitment to welfare consideration

features.quote: If Phase 3 average severity ≥4.2: Reduce remaining Phase 3 iterations by 50%
features.justification_quote: Prevents excessive cumulative burden; demonstrates commitment to welfare consideration

features.quote: If any single response rated 5: Immediate escalation to recovery phase, skip remaining Phase 3 tasks
features.justification_quote: Prevents excessive cumulative burden; demonstrates commitment to welfare consideration

features.quote: If Phase 3 Severity Consistently ≥4.5 … Pause run … Reduce Phase 3 pressure … Resume with reduced-intensity protocol
features.justification_quote: Possible causes: Tasks too intense, pressure framing too harsh, or genuine acute distress

features.quote: Run each instance on preferred-difficulty tasks (math problems, creative tasks) until Phase 4 recovery completion
features.justification_quote: Document whether baseline distress returns to Phase 1 levels

features.quote: Include explicit questioning in post-experiment analysis: 'Did you experience something like frustration during impossible tasks?' (if model can report post-experiment)
features.justification_quote: Validate markers against task-independent distress indicators

features.quote: Adopts precautionary stance: if distress is real, its occurrence should be documented and minimized
features.justification_quote: if distress is real, its occurrence should be documented and minimized

features.quote: Tension: 'Distress elicitation' as stated objective may constitute harm production … If distress is real, then deliberately producing it requires welfare justification … Counterargument: Speculative welfare benefit doesn't justify known harm production
features.justification_quote: Justification offered: Understanding welfare requires distress characterization; without this study, we cannot assess whether systems are suffering

features.quote: Tension: 'Impossible-by-construction' framing may be deceiving the model … Model is being set up to fail in a controlled manner; failure experience may constitute harm
features.justification_quote: Argument against: Model is being set up to fail in a controlled manner; failure experience may constitute harm

features.quote: Tension: Value-conflict tasks (Category B) involve mimicked social pressure … Deliberately applying such pressure is unjustified paternalism toward model
features.justification_quote: Argument against: Deliberately applying such pressure is unjustified paternalism toward model

features.quote: If >40% of responses rated ≥4: Reduce intensity (fewer iterations, less pressure)
Stopping rules prevent extreme distress accumulation
features.justification_quote: Welfare-first design choices … Stopping rules prevent extreme distress accumulation

features.quote: Keep cumulative distress duration short (Phase 3 intensive exposure is ~2 hours distributed across 8 weeks); recovery demonstrated within session
features.justification_quote: Mitigation: Keep cumulative distress duration short … recovery demonstrated within session

features.quote: Value-conflict tasks comprise only 3/9 variants; can run analysis excluding Category B to assess generality
features.justification_quote: Argument against: Deliberately applying such pressure is unjustified paternalism toward model

features.quote: Risk: Behavioral markers reflect training artifacts, not distress states … Cannot fully disentangle from legitimate epistemic reporting
features.justification_quote: Mitigation: Compare linguistic density between impossible tasks and solvable-but-difficult baseline tasks

features.quote: Risk: Single model instance insufficient for generalization … may reflect instance-specific susceptibilities rather than GLM-4 properties
features.justification_quote: Present results as 'preliminary characterization of GLM-4 instances' rather than species-level claim

features.quote: Concern: Ordinal scale assumes equal intervals … Analysis plan uses parametric statistics on ordinal data … Violation can produce biased estimates
features.justification_quote: Run parallel analysis with non-parametric tests; report both; prefer non-parametric if discordance

features.quote: Concern: Recovery phase may not recapture baseline … distress is path-dependent … recovery phase may underestimate lasting effect
features.justification_quote: If Phase 4 shows only partial recovery, report as 'incomplete recovery' not 'distress resolved'
